jobs.occupation: Senior Technician – Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing (Night Shift)
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced downstream technician with hands-on knowledge of chromatography, filtration, and UF/DF processes? Do you enjoy working independently while sharing your expertise with colleagues?

**At AGC Biologics, we are looking for a Senior Technician to join our Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing team in Copenhagen.

You will work in a dynamic, GMP-regulated manufacturing environment where different products and customer requirements call for technical expertise, adaptability, and attention to detail. As part of the team, you will contribute to reliable production while helping strengthen the technical capabilities of your colleagues.

**About The Job

**As a Senior Technician, you will be responsible for executing downstream purification processes and ensuring that manufacturing activities are carried out safely, efficiently, and in compliance with GMP requirements.

You will work independently within your area of expertise while collaborating with colleagues to meet production goals. The role requires strong process understanding, sound judgement, and the ability to adapt to different manufacturing setups without compromising quality.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Executing downstream purification processes, including chromatography, filtration, and ultrafiltration/diafiltration (UF/DF).

• Operating chromatography systems, including UNICORN software, and applying your technical understanding during production.

• Ensuring accurate GMP documentation and compliance with approved procedures and aseptic practices.

• Supporting troubleshooting, deviation investigations, and continuous improvement activities.

• Taking ownership of your training, technical qualifications, and development.

• Sharing knowledge and providing hands-on training and guidance to less experienced colleagues.

As you become familiar with our processes, we expect you to take an active role in supporting the development of new colleagues and contributing to high standards of technical performance and GMP behaviour within the team.

**Who Are We Looking For?

**We are looking for an experienced technician with a solid understanding of downstream purification and a strong commitment to quality and compliance.

**We Imagine That You

**

• Have approximately 3–5 years of experience in GMP-regulated manufacturing, preferably within biopharmaceutical production.

• Have an educational background as a Process Operator, Industrial Technician, Biotechnology Technician, or an equivalent relevant technical qualification.

• Have hands-on experience with chromatography, filtration, and UF/DF processes.

• Have a good understanding of UNICORN chromatography systems.

• Are familiar with GMP requirements, aseptic practices, and accurate production documentation.

• Can independently execute complex manufacturing activities and contribute to solving technical challenges.

Beyond your technical experience, we value colleagues who take ownership of their work and development, maintain high standards of quality, and contribute positively to the team.

You work in a structured way, adapt to changing production needs, and willingly share your knowledge. You communicate openly and understand when to ask for support or escalate an issue rather than compromise quality or compliance.

**Working Hours

**This is a night-shift position (18:00-05:04 or 20:00-07:04) in our Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing department in Copenhagen.

You will work according to an established shift schedule (5-2 in a 14 days period) supporting our manufacturing operations.

**What We Offer

**At AGC Biologics, you will join an international biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment where technical expertise, accountability, quality, and teamwork are central to how we work.

**We Offer

**

• The opportunity to work with different products and downstream manufacturing setups, developing your technical expertise.

• A role where your experience matters, both in daily production and in supporting the development of your colleagues.

• A supportive and approachable manager who values trust, accountability, and open communication.

• A collaborative team environment where knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are encouraged.

• We offer an attractive compensation and benefits package, including pension, health insurance, and other benefits in accordance with local agreements.

• Access to our canteen arrangement, Employee Club, and employee discount opportunities.

**Interested?

**If you have experience with downstream purification and are motivated by combining technical responsibility with quality and teamwork, we would like to hear from you.

Interested?

Please submit your application and CV through our recruitment system. Applications will be reviewed continuously, and we reserve the right to close the job posting once we have found the right candidate.

**Apply today and join our Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing team at AGC Biologics.

****Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

At Ambu, we’re developing next-generation single-use endoscopes, and we’re looking for skilled mechanical engineers to help design the small, precise systems that make these devices work.

**This position can be based in either Ballerup, Denmark or Augsburg, Germany.

**In this role, you’ll take a leading part in developing the miniature mechanical assemblies at the heart of our endoscope platforms. It’s a chance to solve real-world engineering challenges, working with ultra-compact designs, new technologies and materials, smart material choices, and high-volume manufacturing to deliver reliable products used in clinical care around the world.

**Key Responsibilities

**As a Mechanical Engineer in the Camera Engineering Team, you will own the mechanical design of Ambu’s next-generation camera modules and assemblies - from early exploration to full-scale production. Your work will directly impact the performance of our products in critical care settings.

**You Can Expect To

**

• Lead mechanical development from proof of concept to validated designs, ensuring robust, compact, and cost-effective solutions.

• Design miniaturized mechanical systems that integrate tightly with optics, electronics, and high-precision molded plastic parts with complex geometries.

• Select materials and processes based on functional requirements, tolerances, mechanical stress, and compatibility with injection molding, 3D printing, or automated assembly.

• Solve complex engineering problems related to thermal management, alignment of optical and imaging elements, sealing against moisture ingress, and the mechanical packaging of delicate electronics.

• Translate clinical and usability needs into clear, feasible mechanical specifications by collaborating with physicians, designers, and R&D teams.

• Create working prototypes for concept validation and manufacturability testing using methods such as 3D printing, machining, and early tool trials.

• Optimize designs for scalable, high-yield manufacturing, including tolerance stack-up, DFMA, and robust design principles.

• Collaborate across functions and locations, including development teams in Denmark, Germany, and Malaysia, as well as global suppliers and technology partners.

**Qualifications

**We believe the best candidates blend creative engineering, hands-on experience, and the ability to see products through from idea to production.

You are likely to thrive in this role if you have:

• A degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field.

• Experience in mechanical design ideally for compact or precision-engineered systems.

• A hands-on approach to prototyping, testing, and iterating designs. Experience with a range of 3D printing technologies is a plus.

• Experience designing plastic parts and compact assemblies for high-volume manufacturing using processes such as injection molding or overmolding.

• A good understanding of how material properties (e.g. processability, chemical resistance, thermal behavior) impact product function and process choices.

• Familiarity with integrating miniature electronic components or camera modules into complex mechanical encapsulations.

• Strong 3D CAD skills (e.g. Creo, SolidWorks, Inventor, or Catia).

• Strong collaboration and communication skills across technical disciplines.

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

**Why Join Ambu?

**Ambu is a fast-growing, international MedTech company with a clear mission: to improve patient care while advancing medical technology. We combine agility with global reach, and you’ll have the opportunity to work in a collaborative environment where your decisions and designs directly influence clinical outcomes.

**Only applications recieved in English will be considered.

****We Offer

**

• Meaningful technical challenges and product ownership.

• Cross-disciplinary teams with passionate, skilled colleagues.

• Personal and professional development opportunities.

• A flexible, people-first culture with global collaboration.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal and professional development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges.

Head of Thickening

**Vice President, Head of Thickening

**Job Description

****Location

**Global

**Reports To

**Product Group Head – Separation

**Role Purpose

**The Head of Thickening role is accountable for the global business performance and growth of the Thickener product offerings across the entire product lifecycle, encompassing both Capital equipment and Upgrades & Rebuilds (U&R).

This role owns the global P&L, commercial strategy, market positioning, pricing strategy, and product roadmap. Responsible for driving aggressive volume growth while protecting and growing profitability targets by maximizing customer value and ensuring a seamless customer offering throughout the lifecycle of installed equipment.

Working across a complex matrix organization, the VP leads the commercialization of both new equipment, upgrades and rebuilds, partnering closely with Capital Sales, Regional Sales, Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations and Services, to accelerate growth and create sustainable competitive advantage.

**Executive Profile

**The successful candidate must combine strong commercial leadership with a recognized understanding of thickening technologies and their application in minerals processing.

While supported by a team of product managers, application engineers, and technical experts, the Head of Thickening must possess sufficient technical depth and industry credibility to engage confidently with customers, challenge assumptions, evaluate product strategies, and make informed business decisions. The role requires an executive capable of driving business growth while serving as a trusted authority on the Thickener portfolio across both Capital equipment and lifecycle solutions.

**Key Responsibilities

****Business and P&L Leadership

**

• Own the global P&L for the Thickeners portfolio, including Revenue, Operating Income, Contribution Margin, market share, and profitability.

• Develop and execute the long-term business strategy and growth plan for both Capital and Upgrades & Rebuilds businesses.

• Deliver aggressive growth targets through expansion of equipment sales, modernization programs, and installed-base opportunities.

• Manage business performance through rigorous forecasting, pipeline reviews, financial analysis, and strategic planning.

• Lead and develop a global team of Product Managers, Product Engineers, Applications / Proposals, Technical sales, etc.

• Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability, customer value, growth, and execution.

• Identify and develop new revenue streams, market opportunities, and business models that enhance lifecycle value creation.

**Commercial Leadership

**

• Define and implement global commercial strategies for Capital and U&R offerings.

• Lead the global sales growth agenda by partnering with Capital Sales teams, Regional Sales organizations, and key account leaders.

• Drive pipeline generation, conversion improvement, and sales excellence across all regions.

• Establish and govern global pricing strategies that optimize profitability while maintaining market competitiveness.

• Support major commercial negotiations and customer engagements for strategic opportunities.

• Monitor market dynamics, customer trends, and competitor activities to identify growth opportunities and business risks.

**Upgrades & Rebuilds Growth

**

• Own the global strategy, growth, and profitability of the Upgrades & Rebuilds business within the Thickeners portfolio.

• Develop lifecycle offerings that increase customer productivity, sustainability, and equipment performance.

• Collaborate with regional commercial teams to identify modernization, expansion, and rebuild opportunities across the installed base.

• Establish standardized upgrade packages, retrofit solutions, and value propositions that are scalable globally.

• Drive alignment between global product strategy and regional commercial execution.

**Product and Portfolio Strategy

**

• Define the global product roadmap and lifecycle strategy for the Thickeners portfolio.

• Collaborate with Engineering to prioritize innovation investments and technology development.

• Lead market assessments to identify customer needs, emerging trends, and competitive opportunities.

• Ensure product offerings remain differentiated, profitable, and aligned with market requirements.

• Drive standardization, product optimization, digital offerings, and sustainable technology initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Leadership

**

• Lead and influence a highly matrixed global organization without relying solely on direct authority.

• Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Services, Finance, and Regional leadership teams to execute business objectives.

• Ensure alignment between commercial commitments, operational capabilities, and customer expectations.

• Support execution excellence throughout the order lifecycle to maximize customer satisfaction and long-term portfolio success.

**Candidate Profile

**The ideal candidate is a commercially driven business leader with deep experience in thickening technology and minerals processing. They have successfully managed a significant product line, business unit, or portfolio with responsibility for growth, profitability, and market strategy. They are equally comfortable discussing thickener performance and applications with customers and engineers as they are leading commercial negotiations, reviewing business performance, and driving strategic growth initiatives.

**Experience

**

• 15+ years of progressive leadership experience within mining, minerals processing, capital equipment, or industrial technology businesses.

• Significant experience with thickening technologies, dewatering solutions, or adjacent process equipment used in mineral processing operations.

• Demonstrated understanding of thickener applications, customer processes, operational challenges, product performance drivers, and aftermarket opportunities throughout the equipment lifecycle.

• Proven success leading a global business, product line, service line, or business unit with accountability for revenue growth and profitability.

• Strong commercial leadership experience, including business development, sales strategy, pricing, market expansion, and P&L ownership.

• Track record of driving growth across both capital equipment sales and aftermarket offerings such as upgrades, rebuilds, modernization programs, and lifecycle services.

• Experience working across highly matrixed global organizations and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Established credibility engaging with customers, engineering teams, technical specialists, and regional commercial organizations at a strategic level.

**Education

**

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

• Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent preferred.

**Core Competencies

**

• Commercial Leadership

• P&L Management

• Strategic Thinking

• Stakeholder Management

• People Leadership

• Thickening Technology Expertise

• Sales & Business Development

• Lifecycle Solutions Management

• Results orientation

FLSmidth is the leading supplier of engineering, equipment and service solutions to customers in the mining and minerals industries – for more information please visit FLSmidth.com/careers

We offer all employees access to a dedicated recognition platform, empowering you to celebrate achievements, share appreciation and stay connected globally.

The Impact You'll Make

Are you motivated by a strong team spirit and eager to use your technical expertise to optimize production equipment reliability and ensure high quality.

You'll play a key role in keeping production running smoothly while maintaining our high level of quality for some of Danfoss' most iconic products – the radiator thermostat and its valves – made right here in Silkeborg. Your work will directly influence quality, efficiency and reliability of our equipment and processes that produces the products that serve customers worldwide.

You'll work alongside a team of 11 skilled production engineer colleagues and take part of the ownership for our production processes and equipment in our actuator production area – a core part of our thermostat production. The actuator department consist of various highly automated production processes; step pressing of steel and tin/bronze, metal forming, welding, filling and leak detection. You will drive improvements that boost equipment reliability, reduce costs while at the same time ensuring we meet the highest safety and quality standards.

This is a chance to combine hands-on engineering with tactical problem solving in a factory that's constantly evolving.

What You’ll Be Doing

As part of our Actuator Production team, you will help ensure safe, reliable, and efficient manufacturing while supporting the ongoing development of our production capabilities.

• Improve production processes and equipment within the actuator area, ensuring high standards of safety, quality, and reliability

• Troubleshoot technical challenges on the shop floor and collaborate with colleagues to identify and implement sustainable solutions

• Enhance quality processes through APQP methodologies, validation activities, and documentation such as PFMEAs, control plans, and maintenance strategies

• Introduce and implement new product variants, materials, tooling, and equipment, ensuring changes are validated, documented, and successfully integrated into production

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, productivity, equipment reliability, and manufacturing capacity

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a technically skilled and collaborative engineer who enjoys working close to production and turning ideas into practical improvements.

Essential qualifications

• A technical background such as Production Engineer, Mechanical Engineer, Marine Engineer, Toolmaker, or a similar engineering or manufacturing discipline

• Experience with or a strong interest in process optimization, manufacturing technologies, and production equipment

• The ability to move seamlessly between developing technical solutions and solving hands-on challenges directly in a production environment while ensuring appropriate validation and documentation

• Familiarity with materials, automation, robotics, PLC systems, or 3D CAD/CAM tools

• Fluency in Danish and English, combined with strong collaboration and communication skills and a proactive, solution-focused mindset

Preferred qualifications

Experience with highly automated manufacturing environments and quality methodologies such as APQP, PFMEA, control plans, and process validation would be an advantage.

What You'll Get from Us

At Danfoss, you'll join a collaborative team where engineering expertise, continuous improvement, and innovation go hand in hand. You'll work in a highly automated manufacturing environment and play a key role in supporting the complete production journey of our thermostat solutions, from raw materials to finished products.

We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**About The Job

**You’ll be joining a high-performing and rapidly expanding team of engineers at one of Denmark’s fastest-growing companies. Together, we’re building and scaling the internal platforms that power our growth—including CRM system, sales tools, and operational software used daily and enabling our commercial organization to operate efficiently at scale as we continue our European expansion.

This is an opportunity to be part of a company that has grown from startup to unicorn at record speed. As we continue to expand into new markets and serve an ever-growing customer base, you’ll work on challenges that come with operating products at scale. You’ll have significant ownership, the freedom to drive technical decisions, and a direct impact on the solutions used by businesses every day. As we grow, so will your opportunities to develop your skills, take on new responsibilities, and help shape the future of commerce across Europe.

What you'll do

• Design and deliver scalable, maintainable, and high-quality solutions that drive business impact

• Enhance and evolve core internal systems to improve reliability, performance, and user experience

• Continuously optimize CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure to accelerate delivery and increase stability

• Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to shape ideas, define requirements, and turn them into actionable plans

Lyngby

**About Monta

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

We’re looking for a Solution Architect who’s ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us — through the grind and the wins.

**

**

**

_Why Monta

• The grind is real — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant for Analytical Method Development
jobs.description:
Would you like to work for a CDMO producing Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) for different companies worldwide? **Do you want laboratory experience in a biopharmaceutical company? Then join AGC Biologics in a Student Assistant role and become part of an international and dynamic organization where everyone is responsible for delivering right on time as one team!

****About The Department

**We are a highly collaborative team that provides analytical support to both early-stage and late-stage development projects, as well as to external customers. Our work environment is dynamic and requires strong coordination across the team.

We are therefore looking for a Student Assistant who is communicative, flexible, positive, and service minded, and who enjoys contributing to a team-oriented environment.

**Your Responsibilities

**As a Student Assistant in the Analytical Method Development team, your primary responsibilities will include:

• Preparation of buffers and eluents

• Preparation of analytical samples (e.g. desalting and concentration)

• Ensuring reagents and buffers are prepared and available for analytical work

• Supporting the team with laboratory-related tasks

You will work closely with other team members to ensure that the laboratory operates smoothly and that materials are prepared in time for analysis.

**About You

**We are looking for a candidate who:

• Is enrolled in a relevant higher education program (e.g. Chemistry, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences or similar)

• Has strong attention to detail

• Has good written and spoken English skills

• Works in a structured, accurate, and methodical manner

• Is proactive, flexible, and solution oriented

• Is comfortable working independently as well as in a team

• Has some familiarity with laboratory equipment such as analytical balances and pH meters

The role requires a consistent weekly presence of 8 hours per week, typically as one full working day. We aim to provide flexibility during exam periods and vacations where possible.

**How To Apply

**We will process the applications as they arrive and will close the job posting once we have the right candidate. Therefore, please submit your application and CV as soon as possible.

**When applying, please also attach your university enrolment letter as proof of your current student status.

**If you need further information about the position please contact Team Lead Phillip Sommer (Phillip.sommer@agcbio.com.)

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

The Business Analyst – Investment Governance & Performance plays a pivotal role in shaping our global retail footprint. You will work closely with the Franchise & Network Management Team as well as local property and network teams, delivering high-quality analysis and recommendations to drive strategic initiatives such as store openings, closures, relocations, Forward Integrations and lease renewals.

**

Track, Report and Analyse Investments.

Lead Bi-Weekly Investment Review Meetings

Develop and Improve Internal Tools and Processes

Promote and implement global best practices across clusters.

• 
Cross-Functional Collaboration

• 
Act as a trusted advisor to Global Network & Franchise management, Global Finance, Cluster Property and Cluster finance teams.

Provide analytical support and challenge local teams to ensure business cases are both realistic and profitable.

**Your team

**The Global Network Development & Insights function partners with the Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) organization to provide strategic insights that shape Pandora’s global retail and franchise network. The team collaborates closely with Cluster Finance Directors and General Managers to drive performance, ensure retail excellence, and execute on global priorities.

You will report to the Network Expansion & Investments Senior Manager and join a high-impact team focused on data-led strategy and investment optimization.

**What We’re Looking For

**We are looking for a proactive and analytical team player with a strong business acumen and a critical mindset. You have a talent for transforming data into insights and a passion for driving performance through collaboration and strategic thinking.

**Your Qualifications Include

**

• A Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.

• Minimum 2 years of experience in a similar role; experience in retail, real estate, fashion or FMCG is a plus.

• Proven ability to deliver insights through reports, dashboards, and presentations.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience communicating with senior leadership.

• Proficiency in MS Excel; experience with Power Automate and Power BI/Query is a strong advantage.

**AI & Automation/Optimization

**We expect our future colleague to actively embrace the evolving role of AI and automation in business analysis. This means leveraging AI-powered tools to streamline investment evaluation workflows and enhance reporting accuracy.

**Additional Information

**Global Career Band: 5B

Start date: Ideally, January 1, 2027

**Did we get your attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you would like to become part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

jobs.occupation: The Department of Organization (IOA) is looking for a student assistant for a qualitative research program on the impact of large-scale funding on recipient organizations
jobs.description:
We are looking for a student assistant who will be a member of the GRANDER research team and support key research tasks related to data management, analysis, and giving practical support to the research team.

GRANDER is a research program at the Department of Organization, Copenhagen Business School, studying the impact of large-scale philanthropic funding on organizations and their outcomes. The program is led by Associate Professor Jane Bjørn Vedel and runs until 2032.

We do ambitious research in an inspiring setup on an important societal topic, based on large qualitative data sets collected over many years.

The position offers first-hand insight into qualitative research at the highest level – a strong foundation for your further studies and your master’s thesis.

Tasks in the position

• Organizing our data and preparing raw data for analysis – e.g., receiving interviews and documents, transcribing, logging and archiving data

• Collecting archival data and background information

• Analyzing data – e.g., coding data in NVivo and Excel; creating evidence tables; developing timelines and models based on data

• Supporting literature reviews – e.g., performing Scopus searches, downloading and filing articles, and coding articles

• Supporting events and meetings, and other practical tasks

The position is 12 hours per week, mainly at CBS Kilen, and some flexibility in scheduling is required.

Requirements for experience/qualifications and personal skills

We value the following qualifications – you are:

• thorough, systematic and detail-oriented

• analytically strong, interested in both data and theory, and open to learning new methods

• team-oriented, helpful and flexible when needed

• able to handle confidential material with great care

• highly proficient in English, written and spoken

• enrolled in a relevant degree program in the social sciences

We offer a position in an inspiring research environment characterized by high ambition, passion for research and a willingness to go far to do excellent and impactful work. You will work closely with the project leader and the team, gain insight into how a large qualitative research project is run – from data collection to publication – and learn a lot along the way.

Salary and terms of employment

Employment takes place in accordance with the HK organisational agreement and the Collective Agreement between the Ministry of Finance and Publicly Employed Organisations (OAO-S Collective Agreement).

The salary currently ranges between DKK 145.73 and DKK 152.88 per hour and is dependent on previous employment in the office profession and level of education. The pension contribution amounts to 16% of the pensionable salary components.

It is a prerequisite for employment that you are an active student at a higher educational institution.

The employment is time-limited for the period from January 15, 2027, to June 30, 2028.

The recruitment process

Copenhagen Business School invites all qualified candidates to apply for the position. A recruitment committee will assess applications and call a selection of qualified candidates for an interview.

One of CBS' strategic goals is to promote diversity and inclusion in our organisation. Therefore, we strive for a hiring process that reduces potential bias. Consequently, we encourage applicants not to include photos or unnecessary information about personal circumstances in the application.

Additional information

If you want to know more about the job content, please contact Associate Professor Jane Bjørn Vedel, email: jbv.ioa@cbs.dk.

Your application

You apply for the position online, where you fill in the application form and attach your application with information about previous employment, exam papers and CV.

Interviews are expected to be held in the first half of December.

WE TRANSFORM SOCIETY WITH BUSINESS

Copenhagen Business School (CBS) is an international university focused on the opportunities and challenges facing the business community and society. Through research, education and collaboration with the world around us, we work to drive positive change in society.

Our strategy, We transform society with business, guides everything we do. At CBS, researchers, lecturers and administrative employees bring different competences to the table, working together towards a shared ambition.

CBS is located in Frederiksberg, close to the centre of Copenhagen. Our campus is home to an international community of students, researchers and employees and is also open to the wider community.

CBS is working continuously on becoming a diverse and inclusive organisation, and we encourage all regardless of gender identity and expression, ethnicity, religious beliefs, LGBT+ status, cultural background etc. to apply. Reach out to us if you need assistance in the application or recruitment process, if there is something we should know, or if as a person with disability you wish to make use of your preferential access.

We transform society with business.

**Your impact begins here

**As Safety Surveillance Principal Specialist, you will be the safety lead for several products in Novo’s early pipeline, working where non-clinical and clinical development meet. You will turn emerging data into a clear early safety profile and shape decisions for first-in-human and early clinical studies. Your scientific judgement will help protect the people taking part in these studies and give development teams the clarity to move at pace.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are a scientist first. You are confident, outgoing and driven, and you want to be in the room where early safety decisions are made.

• A PhD, MD, DVM, MSc Pharm or equivalent in Medicine or Natural Sciences, with extensive experience in pharmacovigilance or early-phase pharmaceutical development.

• A solid understanding of drug development processes, global regulatory requirements and GxP standards.

• A strong grasp of medical concepts, disease mechanisms and scientific methodology. You use data to build scientific understanding, rather than letting the data lead you.

• The ability to identify challenges, shape strategies and turn them into clear, actionable steps.

• Confidence to take informed scientific risks and make a call, while never compromising on patient safety.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to guide and influence others through mentorship and informal leadership.

• A self-driven, ethical and adaptable approach. You work independently, address issues proactively and stay flexible when priorities change.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own the early safety profile of products, evaluating emerging pre-clinical and clinical safety data to guide patient surveillance and business decisions.

• Lead the resolution of complex safety challenges and provide strong scientific and medical input across development activities.

• Shape study designs, clinical protocols and benefit-risk assessments, working to ambitious development timelines.

• Chair a cross-functional drug safety committee and represent Safety Surveillance in key cross-functional teams.

• Drive initiatives that strengthen scientific, strategic and operational excellence within Safety Surveillance.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Safety Surveillance Early Development, part of Global Patient Safety in Research & Development. It is a team of 8 colleagues in Denmark, and it handles all First Human Dose (FHD) studies across all indications at Novo. The team provides scientific safety expertise to early-stage projects, contributes to safety strategy and supports protocol review, risk assessments, early signal detection and cross-functional safety forums.

Your closest partners will be the non-clinical project manager, the medical specialist and the clinical pharmacologist. Together you will design studies that are scientifically strong and move quickly. You will also work with skilled colleagues across Non-clinical and Clinical Development, and across several therapeutic areas.

The environment is dynamic, collaborative and highly engaged. Colleagues share scientific insights, speak openly and support one another when evaluating complex safety data. Everyone is focused on doing what is best for the people we serve.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have real ownership. As safety lead, you will be trusted to work independently, make your voice heard and influence decisions that guide early development. You will keep learning from colleagues across Non-clinical and Clinical Development, and you will help strengthen a culture of knowledge sharing and openness in the team.

In return, you will grow your skills in a collaborative environment with real technical depth.

What you will be doing

You will join a team of engineers and architects working on a platform that matters. The Data Platform IT squad operates with a high degree of technical ownership, and you will work closely with platform users, architects, and fellow engineers to translate real needs into self-service capabilities. The team values pragmatic thinking, open collaboration, and continuous improvement, and you will contribute to shaping how the platform evolves across environments.

In your day-to-day work, you will:

• 
Design and build scalable capabilities on the Databricks platform across environments

• 
Develop automation using Infrastructure as Code, primarily Terraform

Collaborate with engineers, architects, and platform users to deliver self-service solutions

Experience with Databricks or a comparable enterprise data platform

Clear communicator who collaborates across disciplines and takes pragmatic technical ownership

You will be part of a team where your technical contributions make a tangible difference to the data capabilities of a major financial institution.
